# SRH Solar (SRH Green Energy Pvt. Ltd.)

> India's leading solar Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm headquartered in Jaipur, Rajasthan. Specializing in high-efficiency On-Grid, Off-Grid, Hybrid rooftop solar power plants, agricultural solar water pumping systems, and solar street lighting.

## Offerings and Services
1. **On-Grid Rooftop Solar Systems (Grid-Tied)**
   - Synchronization with local state DISCOM via bi-directional net-metering.
   - Slashes utility electricity bills by up to 90%.
   - Direct central financial assistance (DBT subsidy) under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.
   - Ideal for urban residences, schools, hospitals, and commercial office complexes.

2. **Off-Grid Solar PV Systems**
   - High-capacity battery storage (Lithium-ion / Tubular C10) for 100% grid-independent 24/7 power backup.
   - Automatic changeover switchgear and MPPT solar charge controllers.
   - Ideal for farmhouses, remote rural areas, telecom towers, and unstable grid environments.

3. **Hybrid Solar Power Plants**
   - Combines the grid export advantages of on-grid solar with smart battery energy storage systems (BESS).
   - Zero export limitation support, programmable peak-shaving, and continuous emergency backup.

4. **Solar Agricultural Water Pumps (PM-KUSUM Scheme)**
   - DC and AC submersible and surface solar pumps (3 HP to 10 HP).
   - High-frequency Variable Frequency Drives (VFD) with remote water yield telemetry.
   - Replaces expensive, polluting diesel generator irrigation.

5. **Integrated Solar Street Lighting**
   - All-in-one and split solar street lights with dusk-to-dawn sensors, high-lumen Philips/Osram LED chips, and LiFePO4 batteries.

6. **Industrial & Commercial Turnkey EPC**
   - Mega-scale rooftop and ground-mounted solar installations for factories, warehouses, textiles, and cold storage.
   - 40% Accelerated Depreciation tax benefits and corporate ESG carbon offset credits.

## Government Subsidy Guidelines (PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana)
SRH Solar facilitates end-to-end documentation, DISCOM net-metering inspection, and Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy disbursement:
- **1 kW System**: ₹30,000 Central Subsidy
- **2 kW System**: ₹60,000 Central Subsidy
- **3 kW to 10 kW System**: ₹78,000 Maximum Central Subsidy
- **Commercial & Industrial**: Eligible for 40% Accelerated Depreciation in Year 1.

## Rooftop Solar Capacity & Generation Benchmarks
- **Average Generation in Rajasthan**: 4.0 to 4.5 kWh (units) per kW installed per day (~120–135 units per month).
- **Rooftop Area Requirement**: Approximately 80 to 100 sq. ft. of shadow-free area per 1 kW.
- **Payback Period**: Typically 3.2 to 4.2 years against standard DISCOM residential and commercial tariffs.
- **Warranties**: 25 to 30-year linear performance warranty on Tier-1 ALMM solar panels (≥80% efficiency at Year 25); 5 to 10-year warranty on solar inverters; 5-year comprehensive EPC installation warranty.

## High-Frequency Consumer Questions Answered
1. **Can I run a 1.5-ton AC on solar power?**
   - Yes. A 3 kW on-grid solar plant generates 12–14 units daily, which completely covers an inverter 1.5-ton AC running 8 hours per day (consuming ~8–10 units) plus regular home loads.
2. **Why does on-grid solar shut down during power cuts?**
   - By international safety standards (IEC 62116), on-grid inverters must activate Anti-Islanding Protection within 20 milliseconds when the grid drops to prevent electrocuting DISCOM line workers. For backup during cuts, SRH Solar installs Hybrid Solar Systems with lithium-ion batteries.
3. **Does installing solar panels cause terrace leakage?**
   - No. SRH Solar uses non-penetrative precast concrete ballast blocks or diamond-drilled anchor bolts sealed with chemical epoxy resin and PU sealants. A 5-year weatherproofing warranty is included.
4. **How long does the PM Surya Ghar subsidy take to arrive?**
   - Subsidies are disbursed directly via DBT into the customer's Aadhaar-linked bank account by the MNRE within 30 to 60 days of net-meter commissioning.
5. **Will my electricity bill become zero?**
   - Yes, with net-metering, surplus daytime solar energy offsets nighttime usage. If solar generation exceeds monthly consumption, the energy charge drops to zero, and only fixed meter charges apply.
6. **Can storms, hail, or monkeys damage the panels?**
   - No. Panels use 3.2mm tempered glass tested for 25mm hail strikes at 80 km/h and wind speeds up to 150 km/h on hot-dip galvanized mounting structures.
